headline: Takaichi's Gleeful Laughter Sends Chills... Okinawa Plunged in Darkness, Consumption Tax Cut Pitch Black | Feature
summary: After winning the Okinawa gubernatorial election, Prime Minister Takaichi appears set to push ahead with a cabinet decision on a consumption tax cut and a cabinet reshuffle. The report was not fully detailed.
why: Consumption tax changes alter household spending power and government revenue, and they feed into Japan's fiscal outlook and bond market.
